description: A progressive nervous system disorder that affects movement.
causes: Loss of dopamine-producing neurons in the brain.
prevention: No known way to prevent, but regular aerobic exercise might reduce risk.
treatment_action: Medications to increase dopamine levels and sometimes surgery.
complications: Thinking difficulties, depression, and swallowing problems.

description: An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs.
symptoms: Chest pain when breathing or coughing
treatment_action: Antibiotics, antivirals, or antifungals depending on the cause.
complications: Bacteria in the bloodstream, difficulty breathing, and lung abscess.

description: A skin disease that causes red, itchy scaly patches.
causes: Immune system problem that causes skin cells to grow faster than usual.
symptoms: Red patches of skin covered with thick, silvery scales
prevention: Moisturize skin and avoid triggers like stress and smoking.
treatment_action: Topical therapy, light therapy, and oral or injected medications.
complications: Psoriatic arthritis and increased risk of cardiovascular disease.
